verdict_note: The nearest designated stop is "PROXY_PRESENTER PATH PROVEN — AUTOMATIC ROUGH CUT STILL REQUIRED", but the blocker is NOT the rough cut: it is upstream of it. Naming it precisely rather than approximating.

renderer_audit.result: NONE — every hit was prose (a workflow-wizard checklist item, topic-scout requiredVisuals entries, one text classifier) or this mission's own contract files. config/comfyui/registry.json holds one workflow family (flux-gguf-1080x1920) and no presenter workflow.
renderer_audit.conclusion: no existing producer, so one had to be built; nothing was duplicated

rejected.wan_comfyui: a generative video model for every Draft beat is slow, GPU-bound, non-deterministic in duration, and cannot guarantee exact beat alignment — the opposite of what a Draft needs
rejected.remotion: lives in a separate repo and needs an npm render pipeline; heavier than a placeholder warrants

why: ffmpeg is already a repository dependency
deterministic — duration is requested, not sampled
obviously a placeholder, which is a feature
strategy.photorealism: explicitly not a goal. The proxy must look like a placeholder so nobody mistakes it for finished visuals.

style.lip_sync_note: declared NONE. Motion is a deterministic idle sine, declared heuristic; no viseme alignment is implemented and none is claimed.

presenter_a_roll_separation: PRESENTER_A_ROLL keeps its capture-class meaning: still absent from PROMPT_MEDIA, still mapped to PRESENTER_CAPTURE in edit-plan.js. The Draft substitute is a distinct PROXY_PRESENTER artifact type, not a new fidelity on a capture class.

gate8.why_still_blocked: gate 8 requires the five gate-7 capture artifacts to exist. They do not, and the gate-7 generator is mode-blind: it asks for real capture execution artifacts and a human capture-readiness marker, knowing nothing about proxy capture.

negatives.production_mode: proxy readiness not applicable; realCaptureEvidence false; evidence retained as history with satisfies_real_capture false

exact_next_primitive.name: DRAFT gate-7 capture-artifact materializer
exact_next_primitive.shape: proxy-capture evidence -> the five canonical gate-7 markdown artifacts (capture-checklist, takes-log, missing-shot-tracker, screen-recording-checklist, audio-capture-checklist)
exact_next_primitive.precedent: exactly the gate-6 pattern: visual-plan-package-materializer projected semantic evidence into canonical package-run markdown. The same shape is needed here.
exact_next_primitive.why_not_now: it is a distinct primitive, and hand-writing those five files or teaching the gate-7 generator to accept a human capture marker in DRAFT would both be the fake-evidence path this whole line of work exists to prevent.
